A pencil '?' is at about x≈2870, y≈4325, below b004. It is not visibly attached to anything. It also appears in the left strip of the fol. 277 image.

An ink double-headed arrow crosses the gutter at the level of b002, with a small mark at the fold. Its attachment to r002 by line level is reasonable. Its target on fol. 277 lies near e.170 but is not certain.

An ink double-headed arrow is to the right of b004 and crosses the gutter. On fol. 277 it continues at the level between d. 455(3) and the cancelled d. 344(5) line, so the exact insertion point is ambiguous.
